newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - No reason to change investment forecast - Fahey.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - No reason to change investment forecast - Fahey.

text.p: Australian Finance Minister John Fahey said on Thursday he saw no need to question the government's forecast for business investment in the 1996/97 financial year.

Asked if the government was still happy with its forecast for business investment to rise 14 percent in 1996/97, Fahey said: "Yes, there's no reason to believe that that needs to be questioned at this stage."
"It was always based on a pick-up occuring in the second half of the financial year," Fahey told reporters.
